decisions.title: F-1 lesson check anchors to task lifecycle: lesson.at >= claim UTC date replaces calendar-day match
decisions.rationale: Same cure shape as #49 changelog precedent: anchor to task lifecycle, drop wall clock. No checking power lost (same-day never verified relevance). Claim anchor always available at archive time

dig.output_excerpt: const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10); entries.some((e) => e && e.at === today) // claim anchor: at 2026-11-18T02:29:14.503Z what=claim

decisions.title: F-1 anchors to task identity: add/skip audit rows carry details.task; archive accepts this task's rows
decisions.rationale: Time window was a proxy for identity, never a requirement. Audit details is the designed free surface. Kills midnight aging and foreign-row loopholes. Supersedes D-101

dig.output_excerpt: detail fields deliberately stay OUTSIDE the self-hash payload; add row details {new_id}; skip row has no details yet

decisions.title: init decisions get explicit init constant: unified writes, init-owned survive class, one-time legacy migration
decisions.rationale: Ghost-wipe at milestone close is the real disease (D-01..D-04 would be silently wiped); render inconsistency is only the symptom. init is a real lifecycle stage, not missing data

dig.output_excerpt: done-owned, null-phase, ghost and dropped rows go; D-01..D-04 -> P0, phases array has no P0

decisions.title: Lessons lifecycle redesign gets its own phase P26, queued before P22; P22 keeps non-lessons ledger work
decisions.rationale: User ruling: the redesign is structural, not a quick-fix batch item. Positioned before P22 so its lessons digestion mechanics land on the new architecture, not the old flat ledger

dig.ruling: User ruling 2026-11-18 during P25 THINK: this redesign work goes to an independent new phase

decisions.title: Ship as two feature branches, two PRs, serial squash-merge: feat/f1-task-anchor Fixes #62, feat/init-phase Fixes #1
decisions.rationale: Required Gate (audit mode) check blocked merging PR 1 with the split's structural reds. User ruling 2026-11-18: one branch, one PR closing #62 and #1, audit-green merge.

observable_truths.description: A task with incidents archives cleanly even when its lesson was recorded before UTC midnight: F-1 passes on this-task audit anchor (cross-midnight reproduction from issue #62 no longer blocks)
A lesson or skip recorded in ANOTHER task's context no longer satisfies F-1 for this task (foreign-row loophole closed)
gos decision add without a claimed task renders Phase as explicit init in DECISIONS.md with a header note; no phantom P0 anywhere in rendered views
Decisions born with birth_phase init survive a milestone close (visible as init-owned in the close report) instead of being ghost-wiped
Two independently squash-merged PRs land the fixes; each merge auto-closes its issue (#62, #1)
observable_truths.desc: One merged PR (all checks green) lands both fixes; its merge auto-closes #62 and #1
observable_truths.waive_reason: delivery truth externally blocked pre-freeze: the squash merge and issue autoclose happen after the branch state freezes; asserted from merged main at ship reporting
